items.title: What Happens When AI Solves Your Life’s Work
items.summary: AI was supposed to upend whole industries, and so far it mostly hasn't — it's changed how people work, not whether fields exist. Then OpenAI dropped 372 novel mathematical proofs, solving 90 of the top 500 open problems at roughly three hours of compute each, and mathematics became the test case: what actually happens when AI solves a field's life's work?
